verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Organizations feature within a realm, realms as isolated tenants, and identity brokering to external OIDC/SAML IdPs configured per realm in the admin console. Together these give each customer its own SSO connection, and a community report confirms production multi-tenant SSO use. However, the evidence never shows an IdP being linked to an organization, and the shown organization settings list only a name. Missing for 10: evidence of domain verification for organizations, explicit just-in-time user provisioning on first brokered login, and documentation tying an identity provider to a specific organization.
